purpose: Freeze a reproducible denominator before assigning completion scores. Measures reusable Go workflow-family coverage, not code readability, a mathematical DRY percentage, percent of lines reused, per-script migration or ISO byte parity.
rule: Preserve the 15-family denominator, 21 discovery crosswalks and all 90 IDs. Apply only the two explicitly approved current-tooling amendments identified by the authoritative scope record. Preserve the original contracts and zero-credit history as archived research goals.
scoring_rule: Full=all material responsibilities of the family have verified shared Go support with declarative inputs and preserved guards. Partial=some shared Go support exists but a material responsibility is missing/held. Unsupported=no verified Go workflow. Partial/unsupported earn zero completion credit; no invented0.5 scores or counts of duplicate historical scripts. Python references/tests may verify Go; operational Python remains an unmet Go responsibility. Reviewed historical disposition earns zero verified-Go credit. A scope amendment does not prove Go support or automatically promote a family.

crosswalk.original_contract: Plan sorted bounded old/new byte edits once, retain preimages/idempotence/exclusive output/readback and registry ownership; no per-script writer. Recipes contain IDs, words, text and explicit old/new states. Existing Go plan/validateEdits/verifySource/patchCopy and Python stream_fix_run already own much of this.

One source-aware word/token grammar, glyph map, markup encoder/decoder and semantic-control checks. Canonical wording remains registry data. Reuse Go encode/controls, Python dialog_codec/text_encoder; do not make one codec handler per chapter.

Shared native metrics, explicit scale, measured wrapping/ink bounds and expansion diagnostics, parameterized by proved consumer geometry. New canonical EN first gets read-only evidence; generated encoded pins then feed strict replay.

Share deterministic word/instruction encoding, fixed-width decoding and reference indexes. Reports classify raw pointers, adjusted-high/signed-low pairs, GP offsets, branch/fallthrough, and interior references. Existing Go references and historical Scanner/Code/Tracer are reuse candidates, not interchangeable proof levels.

Shared ELF/disc/sentinel mapping, self-consistent loader/window capacity and bounded placement/reservations; recipes supply approved ranges and named claims. Enhance existing inspect/plan before adding allocators.
Normalize stable IDs; validate/import authored entries or merge allowed machine fields into a new snapshot. Human wording and machine metadata have different owners.
Compare canonical plan with independently read on-disc bytes/references and propose differences. Report before mutating.
Plan typed equal-size old/new edits, source guards, whole-copy application/revert and readback.
Map VMA/file/ISO ranges and validate or grow ISO9660/ELF/stream capacity.
Decode/encode game text and inspect native line/byte/layout constraints or apply bounded edits.
Create/index/hash immutable snapshots and restore or inventory explicit versions.
Derived exports, progress/structural checks and byte/registry audits from explicit inputs.
Compose reviewed edit sets into a new disposable image/private registry and prove expected-only changes.
Prepare versioned diagnostic hook/counter capture plans; read saved/live values only through an explicitly owned runtime workflow.
Current entrypoint refuses; preserve provenance and use-case record without counting removed historical behavior as current implementation.
crosswalk.exclusion: Historical execution-disposition administration is separate from reusable editing workflows.

crosswalk.original_contract: One PS2 TXD/index/CLUT codec independent of ISO placement and artwork. Retain distinct PSMT4/8/nohdr/PSMCT32 parsing facts and alpha/index invariants; use golden fixtures as well as roundtrips.
Share named ISO/CMB lookup and bounded plan/validate/copy/readback. Reuse existing Go safe writer for future Go authoring; do not create another writer per batch.
Keep one styled glyph/run/layer path and one mask/containment execution path. TTF, game bitmap fonts and hand-designed pixel alphabets are explicit font sources, not three patch executors.
Spec builders are chiefly authored tables plus measurement, not a new engine per batch. Share preview/checkerboard/contact-sheet/manifest mechanics where contracts agree.

Keep transport, input backend, capture/inspection and owned lifecycle as clear responsibilities behind a small runtime toolset. Reuse PID/starttime/ISO-guarded cleanup; never adopt app-wide pkill/flatpak kill or shared log truncation from legacy scenarios.

Represent repeated batch verifications as cohort selector + typed read/decoder/comparison + scenario facts atop owned runtime. Preserve separate fixed-field, narrative, positional-grid, code/hook/capacity and image-state comparisons.

verification_notes: This is an unweighted broad-family metric. Family boundaries affect its value; baseline changes must be versioned and prior percentages kept with their denominator.
Single-asset/source-profile support does not complete a broad workflow family. A shared writer/codec primitive is not an authored renderer or snapshot manager.
The discovery sources are pinned historical study inputs, not a fresh claim that every legacy source remains byte-identical today.
Versioned scope expansion grants zero Go milestone/family or410 retirement credit. Operational Python ownership is retained; unsupported means unproven Go responsibility, not broken Python.
Probe is Partial because inherited static diagnostic facts exist, with all six complete acceptance groups unproven0/6. Static facts/offline reports do not establish owned operational workflows.

The authoritative scope record amends exactly two current obligations; all other 88 milestone rows and every existing credit remain unchanged. General static ELF/BSS allocation and processor-exact arbitrary scale interpretation remain archived research goals, not silently implemented capabilities.

historical_context_plan.qualification: Original f099 context-plan bytes remain unrecovered; current2d6 differs. V1 original pin preserved, not repinned and no all-source-provenance claim. Original family duties remain anchored to the three matching crawl sources.
